no_adcom_quote.quote: An Advisory Committee was not convened as there were no issues raised in the course of NDA review that would benefit from an Advisory Committee discussion.

summary: No advisory committee was convened for the VOSEVI (SOF/VEL/VOX) NDA209195 approval. The review documents consistently state the application was not presented at the Antimicrobial Drug Advisory Committee because SOF/VEL/VOX had breakthrough designation and the benefit/risk assessment did not appear controversial, with no issues arising during review that would benefit from AC discussion. Because no AdComm was held, there are no committee-driven linkages to labeling or postmarketing changes.
